title: Towards Scalable Automated Alignment of LLMs: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature on LLM-as-a-judge evaluation challenges, specifically the tendency of LLMs to favor certain responses based on their order or position in the prompt.
Surveying literature on LLM-based evaluators and their systematic preference for longer responses during automated evaluation.
Surveying literature on LLM evaluators and their tendency to favor and assign higher scores to their own generated responses over those from other models.

Reviewing literature on strong-to-weak distillation and behavior imitation, discussing how relying on a single teacher model introduces algorithmic and representation biases, and exploring multi-teacher mitigation strategies.
